adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration calls `create_table :embeddable_hosts, force: true`, which (per ActiveRecord) will drop the table if it already exists before recreating it. That behavior would destroy any pre-existing `embeddable_hosts` data rather than failing loudly, so the finding is grounded in the diff and describes a real data-loss risk.
